manifest.description: Build, deploy, and operate applications on AWS. Skills to author infrastructure-as-code (CDK, CloudFormation), use core services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, ECS/Fargate, ECR, IAM, Amazon Bedrock with Knowledge Bases and Guardrails, AWS Blocks), select and operate databases across relational, key-value, document, wide-column, graph, time-series, and in-memory engines, and complete common tasks across observability, messaging and streaming, AWS SDKs, cost optimization, and Well-Architected Framework reviews across all six pillars.

defaultPrompt: Scaffold a CDK stack for this app.
Add IAM least-privilege policies for these resources.
Wire up CloudWatch logs and alarms for this service.
interface.longDescription: Build, deploy, and operate applications on AWS. Skills to author infrastructure-as-code (CDK, CloudFormation), use core services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, ECS/Fargate, ECR, IAM, Amazon Bedrock with Knowledge Bases and Guardrails, AWS Blocks), and complete common tasks across observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, CloudTrail, ADOT), messaging and streaming (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Kinesis, MSK), AWS SDKs (boto3, JS v3, Swift), and cost optimization, including OpenSearch Serverless vector stores for Knowledge Bases.
interface.shortDescription: AWS agent plugin with skills and MCP servers

manifest.name: aws-core

meta.description: Build, deploy, and operate applications on AWS
